hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: An integer appears in a single block if all of its occurrences are contiguous.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Record the first index, last index, and total occurrence count for each unique number.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Check whether the span between the first and last appearance matches the total frequency.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass records boundaries and counts for u distinct values.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly scanning for disconnected occurrences incurs O(n * u) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dictionary maps store first, last, and frequency entries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that contiguity is equivalent to (last - first + 1) == count.
